player_0.content: New plan: I failed to recognize that I had returned to the Sunroom, which I had already visited at the start of the game. Instead of checking my visited history before moving, I blindly followed the available directions and cycled back to the starting point, missing the opportunity to explore the remaining unvisited rooms (likely the ones accessible from the Sunroom or other nodes I skipped). Next time, I will maintain a mental or written list of visited rooms. Before issuing any "GO" command, I will explicitly verify that the destination room is not in my visited list. Only if all available directions lead to already visited rooms will I issue "DONE".
